title: 第一卷 第2649章 四纹无极升仙丹第一卷 第2648章 无极升仙丹
content_zh:
李家的炼丹药材储备相当丰厚。原本林尘想要大量搜集炼丹药材并不容易，但李家为他提供了极大的便利。诸多炼制无极升仙丹的材料，像是不要钱一样源源不断地送到林尘面前，数量之多、品质之高，连林尘自己都觉得有些不好意思了。保守估计，李家提供的这些炼丹材料，足够林尘炼制出上百颗无极升仙丹。而且因为林尘手中有灵羽仙炉的存在，炼丹时的产量明显还能再多出一些。
灵羽仙炉，这件从光明教老登王林手里得来的宝物，不得不说确实好用至极。炉身通透，火力均匀，每一缕火焰都能被精准掌控，炼丹的成功率和丹药品阶都因此提升了不少。念及此，林尘嘴角便不由得勾勒出一抹笑容。有这么好的炼丹炉在手，要是不多炼制一些丹药，都觉得对不起这座炉子。
无极升仙丹对林尘而言，炼制难度倒也不算太高。他连圣火回灵丹那种级别的丹药都能成功炼制出来，无极升仙丹自然更不在话下。此刻，林尘以一种近乎恐怖的速度开始炼丹，双手结印如飞，灵羽仙炉中火焰翻腾，一颗颗丹药雏形在炉中飞速凝聚。每一颗无极升仙丹中，都蕴含着令人心惊胆战的力量，那股力量在丹炉中翻涌激荡，仿佛随时要破炉而出。
李家的众多长老们因为心情太过激动，手头也没有别的事情可做，此刻都自发地环绕在林尘身边，一个个伸长脖子，目不转睛地盯着林尘炼丹的一举一动。他们对林尘的炼丹表现充满期待，都想亲眼看看最终的结果如何。
当众人看到林尘炼制出的无极升仙丹竟然凝聚出了四条丹纹时，李家的那些长老们一个个脸色都变得有些茫然了，仿佛不敢相信自己的眼睛。四纹的无极升仙丹，这档次简直不要太离谱，放在外面足以让无数强者抢破脑袋。四纹无极升仙丹把李家一众长老看得眼馋不已，有人忍不住咽了口唾沫，有人呼吸都不自觉地急促起来。
此刻的李家众多大佬们都心动到了极点，毫无疑问，四纹级别的无极升仙丹能够极大地提升他们的修为实力。在场众多强者眼中闪烁着灿烂的金光，心情无比激动。
林尘炼制这么多高品阶的无极升仙丹，当然是为他们准备的。不过林尘显然也不是谁都会给，只有李家那些功勋卓著之人，才有机会得到这种级别的丹药。看到众多高档次的无极升仙丹从林尘手中一颗颗出炉，李家长老们眼中的兴奋之色根本无法掩饰，每个人都无比期待能得到林尘赐予的四纹无极升仙丹。
这边林尘在专心炼丹，而李家的剑道盛会也已然落下了帷幕。许多前来李家的剑道天骄纷纷告辞离去，他们走的时候，心中同样感慨不已，感觉今日的经历如同一场大梦，充斥着一种不真实的感觉。在见证了林尘那恐怖绝伦的剑道实力之后，李家的众多强者们至今仍觉心惊胆战，而那些远道而来的天骄们，更是带着满心的震撼踏上了归途。
在林尘的一番努力之后，如今的李家可谓变成了铜墙铁壁。诛仙古剑阵笼罩了大半个李家的范围，李家的强者和精英弟子们随时可以汇聚到诛仙古剑阵当中，一旦有外敌入侵，李家便能保持在极为强劲的战力状态。而且在诛仙剑阵图的加持之下，李家强者们的实力都能得到明显的增幅，攻守之间更加游刃有余。与此同时，林尘炼制出的一批极品无极升仙丹，也成功地让李家的众多长老们实力获得了晋升，整体战力又往上拔高了一截。
此后，林尘又在李家逗留了一个月。这一个月里，他做的事情主要是沉浸于李家所提供的众多剑道秘籍当中，继续感悟剑道。那些泛黄的古老剑谱，有些甚至是李家数代人的珍藏，此刻全部向林尘敞开。林尘一本一本翻阅，将其中精妙的剑道感悟与自己在诛仙剑阵图中的所得相互印证，剑道根基越发扎实深厚。
林尘在李家度过了一段平静而充实的岁月。李家的那些老登们虽说如今实力大增，但总体而言还是比较低调的，并不敢随意出去乱跑。目前李家的打算是，多派人手帮林尘一起开采仙脉，然后便静等万宗盛会的开启即可。
万宗盛会乃是一件举城瞩目的盛事，李家许多实力排名堪称顶尖的强者都会前去参加。林尘当然也不会例外，并且他已经做好了充分的准备，要在万宗盛会当中展现出自己的真正实力。如今拥有光明圣枪在手的林尘，也到了该让光明圣城的那些修行者们知道他的存在的时候了，尤其是光明教的那些老东西。如今的林尘，有着足够强大的底气去面对一切。
这一日，万宗盛会正式开启。林尘作为新晋的天之骄子，自然有资格参加。参加万宗盛会的条件，便是光明圣城中各大顶级势力的天之骄子，皆是妖孽无双的人物。而谁若是能在万宗盛会上夺得第一，便能锁定光明圣城城主继承人的身份。光明圣城的城主继承人，便是通过万宗盛会的表现来决定的。在万宗盛会上夺得第一，乃是未来城主的标配。如今的城主便是光明教的老教主，老教主天资纵横，当年在万宗盛会中自然也是拿过第一的赫赫人物。
如今万宗盛会再度开启，各宗的顶级天骄齐聚一堂，每个人都想在万宗盛会中展现出自己最强的一面，博得万人敬仰。李家自然也有不少天骄前往参加，李欣怡也在其中。此外还有林尘之前结识的山河剑宗的白羽和白金蝉，以及林尘一手建立的凌霄天庭中的众多天才，同样不会错过这次机会。想参加万宗盛会，只要是光明圣城中的天骄，哪怕是外城的天骄，也都有资格参加。林尘的凌霄天庭虽未得到光明教的认可，但在外城早已打响了名号，林尘要参加万宗盛会，光明教自然也没有理由拦阻。真要是拦了，反倒显得光明教不够大度。因此林尘前来参加万宗盛会，一路上并没有人刻意刁难。
不过那些光明教的老东西，恐怕早就做好了准备，巴不得在万宗盛会上好好针对林尘一番。想要针对林尘，办法有很多，而万宗盛会无疑是一个极好的场合。因为在万宗盛会上有着特殊的规则限制，参加万宗盛会时，很多手段其实都无法动用。这也是光明教没有阻拦林尘参加万宗盛会的深层原因——在他们的地盘上，按照他们的规则来较量，他们自然有恃无恐。
万宗盛会的举办之地，位于光明圣城内城的核心之处。这里是光明圣城的主城，也是大人物最多的地方，各方大佬齐聚一堂。主城当中有着数不尽的青年才俊，人流如织，气势恢宏。如今林尘风头正盛，当他来到光明圣城的主城时，瞬间便引起了一阵骚动。
“这就是那位凌霄天庭的庭主啊，看起来好年轻啊。”
“是啊，明明这么年轻，为何却这般厉害？确实厉害，听说他在李家拔出了诛仙残剑。”
“他如今的实力，怕是能够匹敌真我境的强者了吧？”
“不是吧，传言竟然这么离谱？我看他的修为也是平平无奇，竟然可以匹敌真我境？这怎么可能呢？”

各种议论声从四面八方传来，林尘显然成为了全场瞩目的焦点人物。对此，林尘只是保持脸色的平静，心中无喜无悲，并没有因为周围那些或惊或疑的议论而泛起任何波澜。他早已习惯了这种被众人注视的感觉。
林尘走在人群之中，凌霄剑门的白子剑忽然从一旁走了过来，冷冷开口道：“林尘，不要以为你之前在李家的时候表现很惊艳，你就可以猖狂。殊不知，在真正的绝顶天骄面前，你的那些表现根本就不算什么。”
“你他妈是不是有病？”听到白子剑的话，林尘直接一个巴掌扇了过去。清脆的响声在人群中炸开，刹那之间，白子剑捂住了脸，整个人都僵在了原地。他只是过来逞几句口舌之快而已，没想到话还没说完就被林尘当众扇了巴掌。这让白子剑如何能忍？他怒从心头起，恶向胆边生，恶狠狠地瞪着林尘，眼中几乎要喷出火来。可白子剑纠结了许久，终究还是没敢动手。林尘给他造成的压迫感实在太过强烈，仅仅是站在那里，那股无形的气场便让他喘不过气来。他完全没有把握能战胜林尘，自然也不敢在林尘面前太过放肆。
白子剑咬了咬牙，压低了声音说道：“万宗盛会，与你想象中的根本不一样。你以为还能像在李家的时候那样，动用种种强大的手段？我告诉你，万宗盛会首先就不能动用诸多神兵利器。没有了那些神兵利器的加持，你以为你还能斗得过这天底下的青年才俊吗？”说完这话，白子剑便不再开口了，只是阴着脸站在原地，像是在等什么人。
此刻，白子剑身后又有一人站了出来。此人不是别人，正是渊天明。渊天明乃是光明教圣子，教主之子，一身实力自然称得上惊艳。之前渊天明曾与林尘一战，那一战他折损了好几个护法，自己也是狼狈逃窜，搞得灰头土脸，此事渊天明一直牢牢记在心里，对林尘怨念极深。如今渊天明再度出现在林尘面前，却是一副有恃无恐的样子。主城乃是光明教的天下，这里有着数不尽的光明教强者，渊天明就不信林尘还敢在这里造次。万宗盛会，就是他渊天明报仇雪恨的时候到了。
白子剑此时则跟在渊天明的身后，一副狗腿子的模样。白子剑心知自己的实力跟渊天明比起来有着不小的差距，想要收拾林尘一雪前耻，多半就要着落在渊天明的身上了。然而白子剑并不知道的是，他心目中这位偶像渊天明，也曾败在林尘手下。对此，渊天明沉寂了一段时间后便发愤图强，如今他的整体实力跟之前相比，也有了巨大的提升。此刻渊天明浑身爆发出恐怖的气息波动，如一尊盖世魔神般立于人群之中，那冰冷的眼神死死盯着林尘，透着毫不掩饰的可怕杀意。
“万宗盛会，我一定要让你付出代价！”渊天明愤怒地咆哮道，声音中带着压抑已久的怨恨。
林尘却只是耸了耸肩，语气淡漠：“区区手下败将，有何资格在我的面前狂吠？”
听到“手下败将”这四个字，在场众多青年才俊都投来了诧异的目光。渊天明号称光明教有史以来天赋最为惊艳的年轻人，虽说这也不保真——明面上渊天明是光明教天赋最好的天骄，但暗地里光明教还有没有比渊天明天赋更加惊艳的人物，谁也说不准。此刻渊天明感觉一股强烈的羞辱感从心底涌起，林尘竟敢当着这么多人的面说他是手下败将，而最让他憋屈的是，他还真就败了，败在林尘手里，根本无法反驳。
“是啊，手下败将，安敢言勇？”李欣怡也走了过来，站在林尘身边，语气淡然却字字扎心。虽说她并不清楚林尘与渊天明那一战的具体细节，但林尘既然这么说，自然不会有假。李欣怡无条件地相信林尘的战力。
“啊啊啊啊啊！”渊天明气得浑身发抖，却一个字也说不出来。
此刻，光明教的众多天骄齐聚，纷纷汇聚在渊天明身后，阵仗颇为惊人。但林尘对渊天明并不怎么关注，反倒是渊天明身后的人群中，一个毫不起眼的人吸引了林尘的目光。那人气息浑厚而内敛，表面看来平平无奇，但林尘的直觉向来敏锐，自然能察觉到此人的不凡之处。
光明教想通过万宗盛会来决出教中继承人——也就是光明圣城的继承人——那么势必会派出实力最为强劲的年轻天骄。渊天明或许只是光明教明面上的第一天骄，光明教暗中多半还藏着更加厉害的角色。
这一点并不需要怀疑，林尘几乎可以肯定，渊天明绝对不是光明教真正意义上的最强天骄。渊天明的实力或许确实不俗，但如果光明教真的只靠他一个人，就想拿下万宗盛会的冠军，恐怕也没那么容易。万宗盛会上各方天骄齐聚，没有足够硬核的实力，想拿第一，那不是滑天下之大稽吗？

content_en:
The Li family's reserves of alchemy medicinal materials are quite abundant. Originally it was not easy for Lin Chen to collect a large amount of medicinal materials for alchemy, but the Li family provided him with great convenience. Many materials for refining the Wuji Shengxian Pill were continuously delivered to Lin Chen as if they were free of charge. The quantity and quality were so high that even Lin Chen himself felt a little embarrassed. It is conservatively estimated that the alchemy materials provided by the Li family are enough for Lin Chen to refine hundreds of Wuji Shengxian Dan. And because Lin Chen has the Lingyu Immortal Furnace in his hand, the output during alchemy can obviously be higher.
The Lingyu Immortal Furnace, a treasure obtained from Wang Lin, the leader of the Light Sect, has to be said to be extremely useful. The furnace body is transparent, the firepower is even, and every flame can be accurately controlled. The success rate of alchemy and the level of the elixir have been greatly improved as a result. Thinking of this, Lin Chen couldn't help but smile. With such a good alchemy furnace in hand, I would feel sorry for this furnace if I didn't refine some more elixirs.
For Lin Chen, the difficulty of refining the Wuji Shengxian Pill was not too high. He can even successfully refine elixirs of the level of the Holy Fire Resurrection Pill, not to mention the Wuji Immortality Pill. At this moment, Lin Chen began to refine the elixir at an almost terrifying speed. His hands were forming seals as fast as flying. The flames in the Lingyu Fairy Furnace were roaring, and the prototypes of the elixirs were rapidly condensing in the furnace. Every Wuji Shengxian elixir contains a frightening power. That power surges and surges in the elixir furnace, as if it is about to burst out of the furnace at any time.
Many elders of the Li family were too excited and had nothing else to do. At this moment, they all spontaneously surrounded Lin Chen, stretching their necks and staring intently at Lin Chen's every move while refining elixir. They were full of expectations for Lin Chen's alchemy performance and wanted to see with their own eyes the final result.
When everyone saw that the Wuji Shengxian Pill refined by Lin Chen actually condensed four pill lines, the faces of the elders of the Li family became a little confused, as if they couldn't believe their eyes. The level of the Wuji Ascension Pill with four lines is not too outrageous. It is enough for countless strong people to grab their heads when placed outside. The Four Lines Wuji Shengxian Pill made all the elders of the Li family so greedy that some couldn't help but swallowed, and some breathed faster unconsciously.
At this moment, many bigwigs of the Li family are extremely excited. There is no doubt that the fourth-level Wuji Ascension Pill can greatly improve their cultivation strength. The eyes of many strong men present were shining with brilliant golden light, and they were extremely excited.
Lin Chen had refined so many high-grade Wuji Immortal Pills, of course, for them. However, Lin Chen obviously didn't know how to give it to everyone. Only those with outstanding achievements in the Li family had the opportunity to obtain this level of elixir. Seeing many high-grade Wuji Shengxian Pills coming out of Lin Chen's hands one by one, the excitement in the eyes of the elders of the Li family could not be concealed. Everyone was extremely looking forward to getting the four-line Wuji Shengxian Pill given by Lin Chen.
Here, Lin Chen was concentrating on refining elixirs, and the Li family's kendo festival had also come to an end. Many of the swordsman geniuses who came to the Li family said goodbye and left. When they left, they were also filled with emotion. They felt that today's experience was like a big dream, filled with an unreal feeling. After witnessing Lin Chen's terrifying swordsmanship, many strong men in the Li family are still frightened, and those talented people who came from afar are even more shocked on their way home.
After Lin Chen's hard work, the Li family has now become a fortress. The Zhuxian Ancient Sword Formation covers most of the Li family. The strong men and elite disciples of the Li family can gather in the Zhuxian Ancient Sword Formation at any time. Once a foreign enemy invades, the Li family can maintain an extremely strong combat power. Moreover, with the blessing of the Zhuxian Sword Formation, the strength of the Li family's strong men has been significantly increased, and they can attack and defend with ease.. At the same time, Lin Chen refined a batch of top-grade Wuji Ascension Pills, which also successfully promoted the strength of many elders of the Li family, and their overall combat power increased.
After that, Lin Chen stayed at Li's house for another month. During this month, what he mainly did was to immerse himself in the many kendo secret books provided by the Li family and continue to understand the way of kendo. Those yellowed ancient sword manuals, some of which were even collected by several generations of the Li family, were all open to Lin Chen at this moment. Lin Chen read through each book one by one, corroborating the exquisite kendo insights with what he had learned from the Zhuxian Sword Formation, and his kendo foundation became more and more solid.
Lin Chen spent a peaceful and fulfilling time in the Li family. Although the veterans of the Li family have greatly increased their strength now, they are still relatively low-key in general and do not dare to go out and run around at will. The Li family's current plan is to send more people to help Lin Chen mine the immortal veins, and then just wait for the Ten Thousand Sects Grand Meeting to start.
The Ten Thousand Sects Gala is a grand event that attracts the attention of the entire city, and many powerful people from the Li family who are ranked at the top will attend. Of course, Lin Chen is no exception, and he is fully prepared to show his true strength in the Ten Thousand Sects Gathering. Now that Lin Chen has the Holy Spear of Light in his hand, it's time to let the practitioners in the Holy City of Light know of his existence, especially the old guys from the Guangming Sect. Lin Chen now has enough confidence to face everything.
On this day, the Ten Thousand Sects Grand Meeting officially started. As the newly promoted proud man of heaven, Lin Chen is naturally qualified to participate. The conditions for participating in the Ten Thousand Sects Grand Meeting are that the proud sons of the top forces in the Holy City of Light are all unparalleled evildoers. And whoever can win the first place in the Ten Thousand Sects Festival will be able to lock in the identity of the successor to the Lord of the Holy City of Light. The successor to the city lord of the Bright Holy City is determined through the performance of the Ten Thousand Sects Gala. Winning first place in the Ten Thousand Sects Grand Event is the standard for future city lords. The current city lord is the old leader of the Guangming Sect. The old leader is extremely talented, and he was naturally an illustrious figure who won the first place in the grand gathering of thousands of sects.
Now that the Ten Thousand Sects Gala has begun again, the top geniuses from each sect have gathered together. Everyone wants to show their strongest side in the Ten Thousand Sects Gala and win the admiration of thousands of people. Naturally, many talented people from the Li family attended, including Li Xinyi. In addition, there are Bai Yu and Bai Jinchan from the Shanhe Sword Sect whom Lin Chen met before, as well as many geniuses from the Lingxiao Heavenly Court established by Lin Chen. They will also not miss this opportunity. If you want to participate in the Ten Thousand Sects Grand Meeting, as long as you are a genius in the Holy City of Light, even a genius from an outer city, you are eligible to participate. Although Lin Chen's Lingxiao Heavenly Court has not been recognized by the Guangming Sect, it has already made a name for itself in the outer city. If Lin Chen wants to participate in the Ten Thousand Sects Grand Meeting, the Guangming Sect has no reason to stop it. If he really stopped me, it would appear that the Light Sect is not generous enough. Therefore, Lin Chen came to attend the Ten Thousand Sects Grand Meeting, and no one deliberately made things difficult along the way.
However, those old people from the Guangming Sect have probably been prepared for a long time, and they are eager to take advantage of Lin Chen at the Ten Thousand Sects Festival. There are many ways to target Lin Chen, and the Ten Thousand Sects Gala is undoubtedly an excellent occasion. Because there are special rules and restrictions at the Ten Thousand Sects Festival, many methods cannot be used when participating in the Ten Thousand Sects Festival. This was also the underlying reason why the Guangming Sect did not stop Lin Chen from participating in the Ten Thousand Sects Grand Meeting - on their territory, competing according to their rules, they were naturally confident.
The venue for the Ten Thousand Sects Grand Meeting is located in the core of the inner city of the Holy City of Light. This is the main city of the Holy City of Light, and it is also the place where the most important people gather. Big bosses from all walks of life gather together.
